title: A Study to Evaluate the Safety, PK, PD and Efficacy of VSA012 Injection in PNH Patient
official: Phase I/II Clinical Study to Evaluate the Safety, Tolerability, Pharmacokinetics, Pharmacodynamics, and Preliminary Efficacy of VSA012 Injection in Participants with Paroxysmal Nocturnal Hemoglobinuria (PNH) Who Are Complement Inhibitor Naïve or Have Not Received Complement Inhibitor Therapy Recently, as well as in Those with Persistent Anemia Despite Stable C5 Complement Inhibitor Therapy
summary:
Main objective: •	To evaluate the safety and tolerability of VSA012 in participants with PNH;
•	To evaluate the preliminary efficacy of VSA012 in participants with PNH.
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Please refer to Inclusion Criteria for Groups 1-4 and 6 in the Protocol
2. Please refer to Inclusion Criteria for Groups 5 and 7 in the Protocol
Exclusion criteria:
1. Please refer to Exclusion Criteria for Groups 1-4 and 6 in the Protocol
2. Please refer to Exclusion Criteria for Groups 5 and 7 in the Protocol
